'''Extel''' was the front man for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] operations to increase his influence on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] by acquiring a stake in an arena specializing in [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] tournaments. Because of the bold move, local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Wonn Ionstrike/Legends|Wonn Ionstrike]] swore to drive Extel out of the city.<ref name="GG2-2" />
